issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect Milkable.messageOnMilk() to be a no-argument method returning a String (UML and example usage), but the solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) with a double parameter. This parameter mismatch prevents consistency between specification, template usage, and solution implementations (Seal and Goat), and would confuse students about the correct method signature to implement and call.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution so Milkable.messageOnMilk() has no parameters and returns the String "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (update Seal and Goat accordingly), or (B) update the problem statement and template to specify a messageOnMilk(double volume) signature (and adjust example usages to pass a volume). Option A is recommended to match the UML and template usage.

issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a parameterless Milkable.messageOnMilk() that returns a String (signature: messageOnMilk()), but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (adds a double parameter) and implementations include the volume in the returned string. This mismatch of the method signature (and the expected return text) prevents a clear mapping between the exercise description/template usage (which call messageOnMilk() with no arguments) and the solution API, and will confuse or break students' code when they follow the instructions or use the provided Main template.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem/template by changing the Milkable interface and its implementations to the parameterless signature: String messageOnMilk(). Update Seal and Goat to implement messageOnMilk() returning the exact format specified in the problem (e.g., "Seal Clarabelle is milked"). Alternatively, if the volume parameter is desired pedagogically, update the problem statement and the template (Main) to document and call messageOnMilk(double volume) and show the expected return format including the volume.
